title: avoid empty tool call messages
request: Hey, can we stop ActionStep from adding a TOOL_CALL message when the tool_calls list is empty? Right now it still creates a "Calling tools:" entry even with no calls, which clutters the output.
reference_diff:
--- a/src/smolagents/memory.py
+++ b/src/smolagents/memory.py
@@ -96,7 +96,7 @@
                 ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content=[{"type": "text", "text": self.model_output.strip()}])
             )
 
-        if self.tool_calls is not None:
+        if self.tool_calls:
             messages.append(
                 ChatMessage(
                     role=MessageRole.TOOL_CALL,
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_memory_tool_calls.py
@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+import pytest
+from smolagents.memory import ActionStep, MessageRole
+from smolagents.monitoring import Timing
+
+
+def test_action_step_to_messages_empty_tool_calls():
+    """ActionStep should not emit a TOOL_CALL message when tool_calls is an empty list."""
+    step = ActionStep(
+        step_number=1,
+        timing=Timing(start_time=0.0, end_time=1.0),
+        model_output="Hello",
+        tool_calls=[],
+    )
+    messages = step.to_messages()
+    # Only the assistant message (model_output) should be present
+    assert len(messages) == 1
+    assert messages[0].role == MessageRole.ASSISTANT
+    assert messages[0].content[0]["type"] == "text"
+    assert messages[0].content[0]["text"] == "Hello"
